poseFit.note: src/ui/poses.ts poseFit() sizes a pose by its painted area (alpha > 110 on a 96 px sample), so a pose's draw scale per sprite pixel, against idle's, is sqrt(idle.area / pose.area) at the same pixel scale; the export size can't change it. ready, think and listen measure x1.00 +/- 0.01. A bow folds the arms over the chest and covers less, so every candidate that clearly bows measures x1.08-1.15. The picks agree (x1.084, x1.102), so one TWEAK (bow: 0.915, requested from F1 in docs/fix-requests.md) brings both within 1% (x0.992, x1.008), as flip's 0.9 does.
